info.title: NetTerrain
info.description: Authentication: HTTP Basic. NetTerrain is a data center infrastructure management (DCIM) and network documentation platform by Graphical Networks, covering racks, devices, connections, and diagram hierarchy.
info.x-itential-curated: Trimmed to 52 of 261 upstream operations covering common CRUD for automation: nodes, devices, racks, links (connections), circuits, node/device/rack types, vendors, hierarchy, and search. See the repo README for the full scope and the full spec.

put.description:
System node types cannot be updated. The system parameter cannot be altered either. The type group of the node type cannot be changed. When altering the name parameter (renaming the node type) the new name must be unique. When changing the image or background parameters the image file corresponding to the new file name should already exist on the server. Use an empty string to remove the node icon or background image. A favorite node type or a node type with existing node instances cannot be disabled. The background, vendor, width and height parameters can only be set for node types that were modelled as Racks, Devices and Cards. The hierarchybrowserlabel (Hierarchy browser label) only accepts the property Id of properties belonging to the current node type. The new template should correspond to a template node. The category should correspond to a node category of the same type group. The displayracklines can only be set to true for the Rack type group.

Use this node type format for node override update: { "name": "Region", "image": "Region.png", "background": "", "default_height": 50, "default_width": 50, "node_type_group": "Node", "is_favorite": true, "is_system": false, "is_enabled": true, "description": "", "is_keep_aspect_ratio": false, "double_click_behavior": "DrillDown", "double_click_behavior_attribute": "", "template": null, "hierarchy_browser_label": { "href": "http://172.30.1.110:80/vis/wapi/v1/node_type_properties/28000000027700" }, "node_category": { "href": "http://172.30.1.110:80/vis/wapi/v1/node_categories/31000000000006" }, "href": "http://172.30.1.110:80/vis/wapi/v1/node_types/26000000002658" }
